name: The Beach
objectsHelp: Things on the map. x and y count tiles from the top left, starting at 0. See the README, 'The beach', for what each kind needs. 'clues' can be added to any object: only a player with that ability sees the text. In clue texts, {d1} {d2} {d3} become the digits of the garden gate's code, which is new in every mission. An npc's 'lines' are sentences the teacher can send from the teacher panel.

goal.label: Lanterns
goal.story: Find three lanterns and bring them to the lighthouse keeper.

placesHelp: Named places. Students use them to say where to meet (couriers). x and y are the middle of the place.
landmarksHelp: What missions restore, in this order unless a mission names one. Each is drawn as a ruin until a mission restores it, then for ever. 'solid': players cannot walk through it. w and h are its size in tiles (x, y is the top left).

clues.read: WELCOME TO LANTERN ISLAND. The lighthouse is dark! Find three lanterns in the stone tablets. The garden gate has a code. Its first number is {d1}.

clues.look: A stone fisherman. Somebody painted a big number on his hat: {d2}. It is the second number of a code.

clues.listen: A small voice inside: "The last number of the code is {d3}."
clues.look: A big pink shell. It is beautiful.

clues.read: OLD BRIDGE. The gate is locked. The key is in the chest behind the big rock, in the north. The bridge is broken: somebody must jump, and stand on the stone on the other side.
WATER GATE. Close it and the sea goes down, so you can walk to the sandbank. It is broken: fix it with a plank.

clues.look: A green bottle with a letter inside.
clues.read: "The keeper takes the lanterns from one pair of hands. One of you must carry all three, and talk to him. - A friend"

clues.listen: You hear the sea... and somebody singing an English song.

objects.name: Lighthouse keeper

clues.talk: "Hello! I am the lighthouse keeper. Please bring me three lanterns. One of you must carry all three."

lines: How many lanterns do you have?
Can you say that again, please?
Thank you! You are a great team.

clues.look: A very big rock. There is something behind it.
